ns2:course.label: Princ Tchg Lit to Child Youth
ns2:course.description: Examines literature written for children and youth and the uses of literature in the school curriculum. Credit is not given for both CI 467 and LIS 403. Prerequisite: One college course in literature; admission to the Elementary Teacher Education Program.
